2608.04589.title: The First EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis 2026: Cross-Domain Egocentric Video Question Answering
2608.04589.paper_summary: EgoCross is a cross-domain egocentric video question answering benchmark designed to evaluate whether multimodal large language models can generalize beyond common daily-life scenarios. The first EgoCross Challenge was hosted at the Third EgoVis Workshop at CVPR 2026 and evaluated models on first-person videos from four target domains: surgery, industrial assembly, extreme sports, and animal perspectives. Each test example consists of an egocentric video clip, a question, and four candidate answers, from which the model must select the correct option. This technical report introduces the challenge task, benchmark resources, and two official Codabench tracks. The Source-Limited Track restricts participants to the official baseline model and a small support set, whereas the Open-Source Track permits broader choices of models and training data under rules that prohibit the manual construction of target-domain training data. In total, the challenge received more than 1,500 submissions from over 130 participants, with 19 teams participating in the Open-Source Track and 38 teams in the Source-Limited Track. We further present the official leaderboard results and summarize the winning solutions from both tracks. We hope that this report will serve as a useful technical reference for advancing cross-domain egocentric video understanding. All resources, including the challenge data, baseline implementation, and code released by the winning teams, are made publicly available.
2608.04589.paper_summary_zh: EgoCross 是一個跨領域的自我中心視頻問答基準，旨在評估多模態大型語言模型是否能超越常見的日常生活場景進行泛化。第一屆 EgoCross 挑戰賽於 2026 年 CVPR 第三屆 EgoVis 研討會上舉行，並對來自四個目標領域的第一人稱視頻進行評估：手術、工業組裝、極限運動和動物視角。每個測試示例由一段自我中心的視頻片段、一個問題和四個候選答案組成，模型必須從中選擇正確的選項。這份技術報告介紹了挑戰任務、基準資源和兩個官方 Codabench 賽道。源限制賽道限制參賽者使用官方基準模型和一小組支持集，而開源賽道則允許在禁止手動構建目標領域訓練數據的規則下，選擇更廣泛的模型和訓練數據。總體而言，挑戰賽收到了來自 130 多位參賽者的超過 1,500 份提交，其中 19 支隊伍參加了開源賽道，38 支隊伍參加了源限制賽道。我們還展示了官方排行榜的結果，並總結了兩個賽道的獲勝解決方案。我們希望這份報告能成為推進跨領域自我中心視頻理解的有用技術參考。所有資源，包括挑戰數據、基準實現和獲勝隊伍釋出的代碼，均已公開提供。
